Maya (People Ops): Quick draft of a manager-first checklist and mentor rubric for Priya's start. Tried to keep it minimal and copyable. Feedback?
Ravi (Hiring Manager): This looks great. Can we add a short "what success looks like" section for 30/60/90 that has measurable outcomes?
Maya (People Ops): Yep below — kept it measurable and tweakable by manager. Also added a sample day-1 calendar you can paste.
buddy-bot: Priya K profile created and onboarding checklist linked. :sparkles:
Sam (IT): Laptop + peripherals ordered, shipping 48h. Please confirm shipping address in Priya's profile. I also enabled SSO but need her MFA set up.
Priya (New Hire): Thanks! I'll update my address now. Question: do we have a standard VPN client and instructions?
Sam (IT): Yes, use "redwood-vpn" (mac/linux/win). Docs: https://confluence/rewood/vpn-setup. Ping me if you hit a snag.
Lena (Eng Lead): I'll add Priya to the squad channel, infra repo, and the CI build access list. Expect invites this afternoon.
Taylor (Buddy): Happy to be the buddy. Proposed plan: 15m daily check-ins first week for quick triage, then 30m twice/week next 3 weeks. I'll run the mentor rubric.
Ravi (Hiring Manager): Preferred 1:1 cadence: weekly with me for 90 days, weekly buddy check-ins for 30 days, then biweekly buddy.
Maya (People Ops): Manager checklist (paste into calendar/invite):
- Day -1: Confirm shipping address, confirm SSO/MFA email sent, Slack invite, payroll paperwork complete
- Day 1 09:00-09:30: Welcome + org overview (People Ops + Manager)
- Day 1 10:00-11:00: Team intro + product context (eng lead)
